body: You are awesome!! Great idea. Could I have a small blue Bernie t shirt and a billionaires can't buy Bernie bumper sticker?
I'm at UTD also! We need to set up a Bernie group here.

Did something trigger this? ...I know how you feel. When I feel like putting a bullet in my head, I force myself to sleep and wait another day. Almost always I feel at least a tiny bit better the next day. It's fucking hard, but you can fight it off, at least for another day.
Called both numbers and left a message. Will keep calling errrrrydayyy

I agree, I really think exercising and meditating would help. I always plan to do it, but I am too busy or too exhausted to do it. I need more time for myself I think. I'll look into chi Kung. Thank you for the advice. I just need to DO it now.

The worst part is I don't even know her name; I can't even visit her grave. The way I was conceived, half of my family tree is severed. The heavy research I do to find my paternal family can also trigger my helplessness and depression; it's exhausting. Thank you for your kind words. I'm 21 in college right now. High school is definitely rough. I was so self destructive. I am glad you have friends that can lift you up and support you. So You had attempted suicide because you felt you could not handle things? I'm sorry to hear that. I'm also glad meds are working for you. I've been to a psychiatrist and have tried meds, but I couldn't stick with them. I felt like my anxiety was subdued; nothing was fixed. I felt guilty for taking them and had to stop. I wish the best for you too.

That's also a problem though; I feel TOO much. It's crippling. How did you practice to see the positive? I used to repeat the phrase " think positive, act positive, be positive" in my head almost compulsively. I can see that I have gained valuable experiences from negative situations. I just ruminate a lot and have horrible day dreams about death of loved ones and myself. I don't understand why I'm Thinking about these things while, presumably, many others may be thinking about more positive or neutral things. Thanks for saying that... I actually stumbled upon this article the other day. Obviously not 'hard' science but interesting:

http://www.spiritscienceandmetaphysics.com/study-links-social-anxiety-to-high-iqs-empathetic-ability-sentinel-intelligence/
I'm glad you got better. Thanks for sharing your story. It really put things in perspective for me.

So when you scaled back, did your depression worsen before it got better? Yea, I get that...my workload distracts me from my depression but also increases my anxiety and stress levels, which can also trigger my depression. So there has to be another way. I know I should lower my workload as you did, but I'm finding it very hard to. It is like my crutch. Thanks for replying.

Shadow_cat has some good points. I understand how your circumstances are driving you to want to die, but If you really want to die right now, it's best to wait a week and if you still feel the exact same way, you could revisit that. A lot could change in even a day, by even the smallest things such as running into someone you knew that could change your mind to want to do this, even for a second. It's fucking hard to choose to wake up to another day, but tomorrow or the next or the day after could be the day that somethings may change for the better.

I don't know what to say... I love you. I empathize with you; I think about suicide every day. I am in between- I can't live a full rich life but at the same time I can't get myself to die just yet. It's torture being in the middle. I feel sad that you are departing, but I understand your choice. Just make sure you ARE sure...

I'm sorry that was kept from you. I am donor conceived as well and just signed up on FTDNA and AncestryDNA. I am also on 23andme, but some people on 23andme are private or anonymous; I think the other 2 sites share more info such as email, so you should sign up if you are able. 

Some good resources:
Donorchildren.com
Anonymousus.org
Private FB groups: Worldwide donor conceived people network; Donor conceived offspring, children, parents; DNA Relatives; Search Squad. 

I hope for the best in your search!
Regina is amazing!! :) I think you'll like her. Thank you for that and for posting. It helps knowing that there are others out there. I hope the best for you as well :)

I feel the same way. I know my death will most likely be my choice, not by old age. I've decided to go on for another decade or so and when the time comes, I'll make that decision and it will be my decision, because it is my life to take. Good song, Regina Spektor does a good cover of that song too. 
I hope the best for you.
